description: solo-review's branch guard. In a repository set up for solo-review, changes reach the default branch only through a reviewed PR, so Claude's file edits and `git commit`s on the default branch are refused until it starts a branch (a plain branch, never a worktree). Ignored files, the .solo-review/ handoff folder, a new repository's first commit and an unfinished rebase or merge are let through. It fails open.
